Render this file from your `EPI553` project folder. Each section reports what it found.

## R version

```{r}
#| label: r-version
cat("R version:", as.character(getRversion()), "\n")
if (getRversion() >= "4.4.0") {
  cat("OK: R is 4.4 or later.\n")
} else {
  cat("UPDATE NEEDED: install R 4.4 or later from https://cloud.r-project.org/\n")
}
```

## Course packages

```{r}
#| label: packages
pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "rmarkdown", "knitr", "kableExtra", "broom",
          "gtsummary", "car", "ggeffects", "janitor", "plotly",
          "NHANES", "brfssdata", "corrplot")
installed <- pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())
data.frame(package = pkgs, installed = ifelse(installed, "yes", "MISSING"))
if (all(installed)) {
  cat("OK: all course packages are installed.\n")
} else {
  cat("Install the missing ones with install.packages(c(",
      paste0('"', pkgs[!installed], '"', collapse = ", "), "))\n")
}
```

## Project folder

```{r}
#| label: folders
cat("This file is in:", basename(getwd()), "\n")
folders <- c("data", "scripts", "outputs", "figures")
data.frame(folder = folders, exists = ifelse(dir.exists(folders), "yes", "MISSING"))
```

If a folder is missing, create it in your file manager or with `dir.create("data")`.

## Test plot and model

```{r}
#| label: test-plot
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of miles per gallon against car weight for 32 cars in the mtcars data, with a fitted line sloping downward."
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x) +
  labs(x = "Weight (1000 lbs)", y = "Miles per gallon",
       title = "If you can see this plot, ggplot2 works")
```

```{r}
#| label: test-model
summary(lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars))$coefficients
```
